caption: The drawing features a rectangular, woven textile sample centered on a light beige background. The textile is composed of a plaid pattern with alternating horizontal and vertical stripes in red, blue-gray, black, and brown colors. There are two prominent wide horizontal red stripes near the top and bottom, separated by narrower black and brown lines, with blue-gray sections filling the spaces between. Vertical stripes of red, blue-gray, and black intersect the horizontal bands, creating a checkered effect. The textile swatch is neatly positioned within a fine, rectangular border drawn on the paper, and the edges of the fabric appear to be slightly frayed. The rest of the image is blank, with the woven sample and border as the only objects present.
title: Homespun Cloth
